semantic_checkpoints.N_positive_and_wrap: Use t%N only with N>0 for dynamics; complete B/H/w endpoint equations at N-1→0.
semantic_checkpoints.natural_guards: Establish source guard before replacing Nat subtraction by signed accounting; no circular reliance on an unguarded update.
semantic_checkpoints.fixed_seed: One fixed initial n,d,k0 selected before all time horizons; no repeated finite-realizer calls varying k0 with horizon.
semantic_checkpoints.safety_timing: safePeriodic at state t excludes palindrome at t+1; conclude IsLychrel(step n) unless initial avoidance is separately assumed.
semantic_checkpoints.exact_inputs: Original full QuotientPath/ValidPeriodic and all finite-cycle safety states; no graph or width-only substitute.
semantic_checkpoints.scope: Conditional adapter of supplied cycle only; no actual cycle witness, safety preservation, arbitrary graph realization, or 196 result.
